mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS treatmentCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) AS treatmentAmount, ROUND(NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(treatment_count), 0), 2) AS avgAmount FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_count), 0) AS treatmentCount, NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) AS treatmentAmount, ROUND(NVL(SUM(treatment_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(treatment_count), 0), 2) AS avgAmount FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_DTL WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY dept_name ORDER BY treatmentCount DESC
SELECT trend_date AS trendDate, NVL(SUM(trend_value), 0) AS trendValue FROM TR_TREAT_STAT_TREND WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY trend_date ORDER BY trend_date
